title: Enumerated binary cube point
statement: Let an executable Vandermonde input have output dimension $n$, and put $\ell=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$. For each index $j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the associated point in $\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$ is the binary-vector enumeration of the index $j$.
hypotheses_covered: Input has an independence order $k$ with $1\le k\le n$
